offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures highly engineered products for aerospace and defense, utility power delivery, and industrial and test markets. Products include filtration and fluid-control components for aircraft and naval vessels, utility test and diagnostic equipment, and RF shielding and test enclosures. Sold mainly to OEMs, utilities, defense agencies and industrial customers.

primary_products.value: filtration and fluid-control components; utility test and diagnostic instruments; RF shielding and test enclosures; naval and aerospace systems components; thermal and sensor products

primary_services.value: utility engineering and consulting; equipment calibration and testing services; aftermarket repair and maintenance

customer_segment.value: B2B: aerospace and defense OEMs, electric utilities, industrial manufacturers, test labs, telecom and tech firms; B2G: U.S. Navy and defense agencies

end_markets.value: aerospace and defense; electric utilities; industrial manufacturing; naval and maritime; telecommunications and electronics testing

revenue_model.value: product sales: filtration, test equipment and enclosures sold to OEMs, utilities and industrial customers; project or contract: long-term defense and naval programs and custom engineered systems; service fees: utility consulting, testing, calibration and aftermarket repair
revenue_model.category: product sales; project or contract; service fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: manufactures engineered products from purchased materials, sold to OEMs, utilities and government; component supplier: supplies filtration and fluid-control parts to aircraft and naval platforms; service provider: provides engineering, testing and calibration services to utilities
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; component supplier; service provider

geography_served.value: global: United States, Europe, Asia and other international markets, with manufacturing sites in several countries

specialization.value: diversified: Aerospace and defense, utility solutions, and test and filtration businesses serving different customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales to OEMs, utilities, defense prime contractors and government; distributors / dealers: independent distributors and sales representatives for test and industrial products

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: defense contracting and export controls (ITAR, DoD rules), aerospace quality certifications such as FAA/AS9100, and environmental rules

notes: Segment details are from memory and may be slightly outdated after recent divestitures and acquisitions.
